summary_ja: 標準的方式によるマーケット・リスク相当額が、リスク感応度方式、デフォルト・リスク、残余リスク・アドオンの各マーケット・リスク相当額の合計額であることを定める。
summary_en: Defines the market risk equivalent amount under the standardized approach as the sum of the amounts under the sensitivities-based method, for default risk and for the residual risk add-on.
paragraphs: The market risk equivalent amount under the standardized approach means the sum of the following market risk equivalent amounts. (i) The market risk equivalent amount based on the sensitivities-based method; (ii) The market risk equivalent amount for default risk; (iii) The market risk equivalent amount for the residual risk add-on.
